chunks: ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, from Ismāʿīl ibn Sahl, from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Yazīd ibn Farqad, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, that he heard him saying:
Whoever receives from the zakat, then no fitrah is due upon him.
And he said: Ibn ʿAmmār said that Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام said: There is no fitrah upon one who receives from the zakat.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbd Allāh, a kunyah of Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام in this context
key_terms.أَخَذَ: received or took, meaning to be a recipient
key_terms.الزَّكَاةِ: zakat, the obligatory alms whose recipients include the poor
key_terms.فِطْرَةٌ: zakat al-fitrah, the alms due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.لَا فِطْرَةَ: no fitrah is due, indicating exemption from the obligation

ai.seo_question: Is zakat al-fitrah obligatory on a person who receives zakat?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that a person who receives zakat is not obligated to pay zakat al-fitrah. It indicates that poverty and financial need remove this obligation from the recipient of zakat.
